title: pfSense or OPNsense: Choosing an Open-Source Firewall
excerpt: Two FreeBSD-based firewall distributions with a shared history: OPNsense began as a fork of pfSense. They do similar jobs, so the choice comes down to release cadence, interface and the add-ons you rely on.
verdict: You can build a solid firewall with either. pfSense suits you if you depend on particular packages from its long-established ecosystem or have existing expertise. OPNsense is the better pick if you value a frequent, predictable release schedule, a modern interface and an open development process.
